pair.title: Connect to MelPump
pair.subtitle: Create an API token on melpump.com under Account Settings > API Tokens and paste it below.
pair.invalid_key_format: That doesn't look like a MelPump API token. Tokens start with "api_".
pair.invalid_key: melpump.com rejected this API token. Check that it is complete and not revoked.
pair.not_logged_in: Please enter your API token first.

repair.title: Update MelPump API token
repair.subtitle: Create a new API token on melpump.com under Account Settings > API Tokens and paste it below.
repair.device_not_found: This API token has no access to this heat pump. Use a token from the account that owns it.

device.auth_failed: melpump.com rejected the API token. Use Repair to enter a new token.
device.no_api_key: This device has no API token yet. Use Repair to enter one.
device.no_write_access: Your API token only has read access to this heat pump.
device.update_failed: Could not update the heat pump: __message__
device.invalid_solar_minutes: Solar mode duration must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
device.preset_not_set: This preset has no temperature set in MelPump. Configure it in the MelPump app first.
device.offline: The heat pump is offline according to MelPump.
device.integration_inactive: MelPump has lost its connection to the heat pump's cloud service. Reconnect the integration in the MelPump app.
device.no_data: MelPump currently receives no data from the heat pump. The values shown may be out of date.
device.invalid_curve_correction: The heat curve correction must be between -10 and 10.
device.invalid_flow_temperature: The flow temperature must be between __min__ and __max__ °C.
device.offline_since: The heat pump is offline according to MelPump. Last data: __time__.
device.subscription_inactive: The MelPump subscription for this heat pump is not active. The MelPump API only works with an active subscription.
device.invalid_end_time: The end time __time__ is invalid or has already passed.

widget.no_device: Add a MelPump heat pump in Homey first.
widget.error: Could not load the heat pump status.
